name: אינטגרל מסוים בשברים חלקיים – 4/(x−1)+3/(x−2) מ-(−1) עד 0 (באנגלית)
questiontext:
By expressing the integrand as the sum of its partial fractions, find the following definite integral:

\[ \int^{{CT:0}}_{{CT:1}} {{CT:2}} d{{CT:3}}. \]

[[input:ans1]]
[[validation:ans1]]
generalfeedback:
Outline: Find an antiderivative \(F\) of the integrand with partial fractions (decomposition, coefficients, term-by-term integration), then evaluate \(F\) at the limits.
Step 1 — The form of the decomposition
In order to calculate this integral we need to express

\[ {{CT:2}} \]

as the sum of its partial fractions:
Partial fractions: \( \frac{p(x)}{(x-a)(x-b)}=\frac{A}{x-a}+\frac{B}{x-b} \); a repeated factor \( (x-a)^2 \) gives \( \frac{A}{x-a}+\frac{B}{(x-a)^2} \); an irreducible \( x^2+bx+c \) gives \( \frac{Ax+B}{x^2+bx+c} \)

\[ {{CT:2}} = \frac{A}{{{CT:4}}}+\frac{B}{{{CT:5}}} \]

Step 2 — Finding the coefficients
Multiplying both sides by \(\left({{CT:4}}\right)\left({{CT:5}}\right)\) gives

\[ {{CT:6}} = A\left({{CT:5}}\right)+B\left({{CT:4}}\right) \]

Substituting \({{CT:3}}={{CT:7}}\) makes the \(B\) term vanish:

\[ {{CT:8}} = A\cdot \left({{CT:9}}\right)\quad\Rightarrow\quad A={{CT:10}} \]

Substituting \({{CT:3}}={{CT:11}}\) makes the \(A\) term vanish:

\[ {{CT:12}} = B\cdot \left({{CT:13}}\right)\quad\Rightarrow\quad B={{CT:14}} \]

Hence

\[ {{CT:2}} = {{CT:15}}, \]

Step 3 — An antiderivative
Integrating term by term,

\[ \begin{array}{rcl}\displaystyle \int {{CT:2}} d{{CT:3}} &\displaystyle =&\displaystyle \int {{CT:15}} d{{CT:3}} \\ &\displaystyle =&\displaystyle {{CT:10}} \int {{CT:16}} d{{CT:3}} + {{CT:14}} \int {{CT:17}} d{{CT:3}} \\ &\displaystyle =&\displaystyle {{CT:18}} + {{CT:19}} +c \end{array} \]

Step 4 — Substituting the limits
Recall that if

\[ \int f(x) dx = F(x) \]

then

\[ \int^a_b f(x) dx = F(a) - F(b). \]

Then,

\[ \begin{array}{rcl}\displaystyle \int^{{CT:0}}_{{CT:1}} {{CT:2}} d{{CT:3}} &\displaystyle =&\displaystyle F({{CT:0}}) - F({{CT:1}}) \\ &\displaystyle =&\displaystyle {{CT:20}} - [{{CT:21}}] \\ &\displaystyle =&\displaystyle {{CT:22}} \end{array} \]
